temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa seems overburdened by community service tasks; she says she can manage but has a lot to do, then accepts help organizing medical supplies.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: No specific prior belief about Teresa needing help in this project.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Noticing her strain and her eventual acceptance changes his belief: Teresa is overwhelmed and could benefit from assistance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa needs help and is willing to accept it when offered supportively.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer assistance and help Teresa with organizing the medical supplies.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa hesitates and says she wants to prove she can do it by herself; after his reassurance she thanks him and acknowledges teamwork can help.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa is hesitant to accept help because she wants to prove her capability, and he feels empathetic toward her self-reliance.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: His belief is confirmed by her explanation, and he sees that reassurance helps her accept that teamwork does not undermine her ability.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa can accept help without feeling inadequate; teamwork is valuable and she is more open to support.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Teresa and encourage a teamwork-based approach.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa still seems to be struggling; she says it has been a busy day and she feels behind, then agrees to try working together.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa has understood that accepting help is acceptable, but he is uncertain whether his previous reassurance and help have resolved her burden.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Seeing her still struggle changes his belief: reassurance alone is not enough, and a shared collaborative approach may be more effective.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa is still struggling but is willing to try a team approach; working together may ease her burden without making her feel inadequate.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Frustrated and concerned, then hopeful as Teresa agrees.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Find another way to support Teresa without making her feel inadequate; propose and begin a collaborative approach.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees the collaborative approach is already less overwhelming; they divide tasks with Arthur handling inventory and Teresa managing patient records.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Working together can ease Teresa's burden and improve efficiency.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Teresa's positive response and the plan confirm that the collaborative approach is effective and accepted.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Collaboration is easing the burden, improving efficiency, and will help them have a productive day.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Fully commit to the collaborative approach, handle inventory, check in regularly, and keep momentum going.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees their teamwork paid off, calls it a great experience, and supports continuing the collaborative approach in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Their collaboration has been effective and productive, and may be worth continuing.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Teresa's positive reflection confirms that collaboration strengthened their professional relationship and should be maintained.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: The collaborative approach benefits their work and relationship; it should continue in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the collaborative approach in future projects and continue supporting Teresa as a colleague.
